description: This file defines the 'AccessTokenInterface' interface for the 'league/oauth2-client' library, specifying methods related to OAuth2 access tokens such as retrieving token strings, expiration, refresh tokens, and serialization.
external_files: ReturnTypeWillChange (attribute from PHP 8.1 for backward compatibility)

classes.name: AccessTokenInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for OAuth2 access token objects, including methods to retrieve token data and serialize the token.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the refresh token if available.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp in seconds if set.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired; throws an exception if 'expires' is not set.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns additional custom values stored in the token.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the access token.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Provides data for JSON encoding of the token object.
